text:
sylvia: Quick thread 1: planning a mid-month newsletter to surface the new Lighthouse benchmark + a short live demo on 4/12. Goal: drive downloads and webinar RSVPs. Want to split-test 3 subject approaches and 4 audience slices. Who can own segments & send windows?

noah: I got segments. Rough ideas: A) Power users (daily active last 14d), B) Recent signups (<30d), C) Mobile-only users, D) Quiet list (90+ days no opens). Different CTAs per slice.

quentin: Subject tests: 1) "How top teams cut inference bills — new Lighthouse benchmark" 2) "Lighthouse: latency, cost, and model winners" 3) "Benchmarks + live demo: 4/12 (limited seats)" Preheaders: "Numbers you can act on" vs "Reserve your seat"

tara: Add `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=lighthouse_apr&utm_term=segA` to all links. Also add header `X-Campaign: lighthouse_apr_v2` so infra can tag.

asha: Creative note 1: hero should be a simplified heatmap + pull quote from the report. Two CTAs: primary "Get the Lighthouse report" (gated), secondary "Save a spot: 4/12 demo". For recent signups make the demo primary.

noah: Segment SQL snippets I'll paste in the docs:
```
SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE last_active >= now() - interval '14 days' AND email_opt_in = true AND tags NOT IN ('do-not-email')
```

quentin: For quiet list let's stagger send: send A at 10am PT, B at 2pm PT; and if no opens in 48h, try subject variant 3 with a softer CTA.

deliverability-bot: Heads up: subject variant 1 contains "cut inference bills" flagged for potential spam score. Consider swapping "bills" -> "costs".

tara: Good catch. Change to "How top teams cut inference costs". Also avoid all-caps in preheader.

asha: I'll prep two hero image crops (desktop + mobile) and alt copy. Need confirmation on file size limits for SendGrid.

noah: I'll exclude unsubscribes and any `do-not-email` tags. Also confirm we suppress any users in the "research-exempt" list.

quentin: Can we personalize subject for recent signups: `{{first_name}}, see benchmark insights for {{company}}`? Small token test.

sylvia: Love it. Action list: noah owns segment SQL and suppression (due today), quentin owns subject variants + preheaders (due EOD), asha owns creative assets and CTA mappings (due tomorrow), tara own UTMs + headers and schedule (due tonight). I'll assemble preflight checklist and start QA thread.

deliverability-bot: Reminder created 1: deliverability review in 24 hours.

noah: I'll run a 1k seed list dry run to staging once creative is up. Tag me for the seed list.

sylvia: Thanks team 1: if anyone sees risky phrasing or image hosting issues, flag here. We'll aim to send next Tues unless QA finds regressions.
